title: Great knife for the money!
text: Great knife for the money!. This is a really nice knife. Quality made, for the money you can't go wrong. Cuts through vegetables easily and flawlessly. This knife also fits well in my hand and makes cooking prep a breeze. This knife also comes in a nice box so it would be perfect for gift giving (think bridal shower or housewarming present). I highly recommend this Konoll knife to every household!
